title: The owner asked whether a shared-savings judge exists; the widening is the consultant's reading
ruling: Owner 23:26 CST Nov 13 (relayed by the consultant, 23:27; triage did not see it): his earlier suggestion (claim-at-merge for records) was applied narrowly; it applies conceptually to much more; he asked "dont we have some judge that identifies opportunities like these as shared savings?". His words are a question, not a build order. The widening of step shared-job-finder (ruling R29, owner 10:22 CST Nov 11) to a judge that asks, when a ruling, rule or guard lands, where else that mistake class or principle applies across repos, is the consultant's reading; the lane shared-savings-gap-read confirmed from the record, 23:33. Whether to build it is the owner's: page item 814 pick-build-shared-savings-judge. Pass 1 (read-only gaps) is not blocked by this.
quote: big picture outcomes based my suggesiton here was applied narrowly when really it applies conceptually to so much like this — dont we have some judge that identifies opportunities like these as “shared savings” is what i coined it as?
